query_registry: query_registry.json: path_id -> original_query, query_text, perspective and source_quote
case_registry: case_registry.json: case_id -> raw Problem/Task/Context, evidence_ids, leakage_group_id
feature_rows: candidate_features.jsonl: (path_id,backbone,case_id) -> Dense/BM25 ranks and scores, matched tokens, rank-RRF terms and path contribution
candidate_pools: mapping_candidate_pools.jsonl: condition/qid/repeat -> all112 ranked candidate IDs and path provenance; do not prefilter Top20 before mapping
labels_kept_only_in_evaluation: existing Stage1 whole-query Silver, never copied into mapping feature inputs
design_notes: Read Task/explicit operational Context for actually performed work. Problem is a need/context, not proof of a capability.
Compare action, object and output; allow genuine cross-industry functional transfer and distinguish inquiry answering from quality-defect diagnosis.
Retrieval rank, token match or high cosine is not a relevance proof. No mapping score or LLM judgment produced here.
Current Silver is whole-query relevance, not independent labels for108 viewpoints. Do not copy a whole-query positive label to every perspective.
Separate future training/evaluation by query/source groups;18 positive pairs are insufficient to claim general model quality.
